name: synteric-investor-pilot
title: Synteric Robotics
description: Synteric Robotics. Public investor brief and pilot offer, plus quarantined contact inquiries. No token. No payment. No cap table. No auto-DM.

tools.name: list_investor_brief
tools.description: Public pre-seed round facts only: stage, focus, one-pager URL, and how to inquire. No cap table. No unpublished numbers. No dollar targets. Read-only.

tools.name: list_pilot_offer
tools.description: What a Synteric field pilot / customer test looks like: use cases, environments, what you provide, timeline posture, and how to inquire. Not a purchase. Read-only.

tools.name: create_investor_inquiry
tools.description: Submit an investor contact. Opens a QUARANTINED ticket tagged investor (not a commitment). A human reviews before any reply. No auto-DM to LPs. Required: name, firm, email. Optional: check_size_range, notes. Honeypot company_website must be empty or omitted. Returns an idempotent ticket id (SYN-INV-…). Re-submitting the same firm+email within the idempotency window returns the same ticket id. Rate-limited. No payment.

firm.description: Fund, family office, or firm name.

email.description: Work email for follow-up after human review.

check_size_range.description: Optional. Self-reported check range, e.g. 50k-150k. Not a term sheet.

notes.description: Optional context: thesis fit, intro source, timing.

company_website.description: Honeypot. Must be empty or omitted.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client key. Same key returns the same ticket id.

tools.name: create_pilot_inquiry
tools.description: Submit a robot pilot / customer-test contact. Opens a QUARANTINED ticket tagged pilot (not a booking and not a sale). A human reviews before any site contact. No auto-DM to job sites. Required: name, org, use_case, site_type, email, phone. Optional: notes. Honeypot company_website must be empty or omitted. Returns an idempotent ticket id (SYN-PIL-…). Re-submitting the same org+email+site_type within the idempotency window returns the same ticket id. Rate-limited. No payment. No calendar hold.

org.description: Company or organization (e.g. restoration franchise, inspector, facility owner).

use_case.description: What you want the robot to do on site.

site_type.description: Environment class, e.g. crawl_space, attic, fire_scene, above_ground_storage_tank, other.

email.description: Work email for follow-up after human review.

phone.description: US phone for scheduling after human review.

notes.description: Optional: location region, hatch size, timeline, hazards.

company_website.description: Honeypot. Must be empty or omitted.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client key. Same key returns the same ticket id.
